svg.title: ebisu homelab data flow
svg.desc: Six flows: public ingress through Cloudflare Tunnel to Jellyfin, split-horizon DNS, LAN-only administration through two MCP servers, the OPNsense change path with timed auto-revert and git commit, secrets and OpenTofu deployment, and services on hold.
svg.text: Target state for the active plan. Addresses are omitted; real values live outside this repository.
No inbound ports are open. Both WAN links sit behind CGNAT, so all public traffic arrives through the connector's outbound tunnel.
The Jellyfin login page is reachable publicly until the edge login gate returns (section 6).
same name, resolves to the tunnel
One name, two answers: LAN clients get the internal address, so local traffic never hairpins out through the tunnel.
Feeds the performance gate before later phases.
